remarks: Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom (field card shows 3 bedrooms), 3-bath Colonial offering 1,747 sq ft of inviting living space, ideally situated on a level corner lot in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods. Full of character and curb appeal, this home features a picturesque wraparound covered porch-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Inside, you'll find a functional living space including a walk-up attic offering excellent storage or potential for future expansion. Enjoy coveted beach rights with Calf Pasture Beach just minutes away and take advantage of the home's unbeatable convenience-close to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, schools, shopping, and the vibrant restaurants and cultural attractions of South Norwalk (SoNo). Whether you're hosting guests, commuting with ease, or simply enjoying New England charm, this home offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and location.
